nodes.name: NiFe-DOSS-LDH coprecipitation
nodes.procedure: NiFe-DOSS-LDHs were prepared from a solution of Na-DOSS in 200 mL of 30/70 (v/v) ethanol/water mixture with a pH of 10–11 adjusted by adding 1 M solution of NaOH. Ni and Fe perchlorates were employed to facilitate the intercalation of DOSS because of the lower affinity of perchlorate with LDHs. The starting solution of Ni(ClO4)2·6H2O and Fe(ClO4)3·xH2O with varying Fe3+/(Ni2++Fe3+) ratios (0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.25) was added dropwise to the solution of Na-DOSS (the molar ratio of Na-DOSS : ClO4- was 2 : 1) with vigorous stirring. During the reaction, the pH of the mixture was kept constant at 10–11 by adding 1 M solution of NaOH. The suspension was aged for 6 h at room temperature under nitrogen gas bubbling. The precipitate was separated by centrifugation at 4000 rpm for 5 min, washed twice with a water/ethanol mixture (30/70, v/v), and dried at 60 °C for 24 h in a vacuum oven.

nodes.name: NiFe-CO3-LDH anion exchange
nodes.procedure: To obtain NiFe-CO3-LDHs, 200 mg of NiFe-DOSS-LDH/x@RT (x = 0.04, 0.11, 0.16, and 0.25) was added to an aqueous solution of sodium carbonate (20 mmol of sodium carbonate in 200 mL of deionized water), and the suspension was shaken for 6 h at room temperature. The solid was separated by centrifugation at 4000 rpm for 10 min, washed twice with deionized water, and dried at 60 °C overnight in a vacuum oven. The products are named NiFe-CO3-LDH/x CO3, where x is the M3+/(M2++M3+) ratio of the product as determined by ICP.

nodes.name: NiFe-Cl-LDH coprecipitation
nodes.procedure: For the preparation of NiFe-Cl-LDH, the starting solution of NiCl2·6H2O and FeCl3·6H2O with an Fe3+/(Ni2++Fe3+) ratio of 0.05 was added dropwise to 200 mL of 0.1 mM NaOH solution (pH = 10–11) with vigorous stirring. The pH of the mixture was kept constant at 10–11 by adding 1 M solution of NaOH. The mixture was aged for 6 h at room temperature. The precipitate was separated by centrifugation, washed twice with 0.1 mM NaOH solution, and dried at 60 °C for 24 h in a vacuum oven.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of NiFe-DOSS-LDH/x@RT show (003), (006), (009), (012), (110) reflections characteristic of LDH with basal spacing 2.41-2.75 nm corresponding to DOSS interlayer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction patterns of NiFe-DOSS-LDH/x@RT (x = 0.04, 0.11, 0.16, and 0.25) are shown in Fig. 1A. The (003), (006), (009), (012), and (110) reflections of LDH were observed.

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR confirms absence of β-Ni(OH)2 (no 3641 cm⁻¹ peak) and presence of DOSS (C-H 2959,2929,2861 cm⁻¹; C=O 1722 cm⁻¹; S=O 1206,1040 cm⁻¹) in NiFe-DOSS-LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 1B shows the FTIR spectra of NiFe-DOSS-LDH/x@RT... The absorption at 2959, 2929, and 2861 cm⁻¹ due to C–H stretching vibration... indicated the presence of DOSS in the products.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM-EDS elemental mapping shows uniform distribution of Ni, Fe, and S in platy particles of NiFe-DOSS-LDH/0.04@RT, indicating no phase segregation.
